Very interesting:
- UP: nothing moved (both stayed in place).
- RIGHT: gray moved 6 to the right (9→15), black didn't move.
So in level 2: LEFT/RIGHT moves only the gray piece by 6 (in the direction pressed), UP doesn't move anything (blocked? gray is at rows 18-29, moving 6 up → rows 12-23, should be fine but... nothing moved!).
Hmm, wait. UP did nothing. Why? Maybe the vertical step is different, or UP is blocked by something. Gray is at rows 18-29. Moving 6 up → 12-23. Nothing there. Moving 3 up → 15-26. Also nothing there. So why didn't UP move?
Maybe in level 2 the vertical movement step is larger, or the piece can only move when... hmm.
Wait, maybe the control model is different: maybe the arrow keys move the piece in the direction pressed, but only when the path is clear, and UP is blocked because... there's nothing above the gray.
Or maybe the piece is "magnetic" to the yellow target: it can only move in directions that bring it closer to the yellow? Gray is at rows 18-29, cols 15-29 (after the RIGHT probe). Yellow is at rows 42-53, cols 3-17. UP moves away from yellow → blocked? LEFT moves horizontally toward yellow (yellow's cols 3-17, gray's cols 15-29; LEFT reduces cols → closer). RIGHT moves away... but RIGHT did move the gray (9→15). Hmm, that contradicts.
Wait, let me re-verify: after the first LEFT probe, gray was at cols 9-23. Then UP: no change. Then RIGHT: gray at cols 15-29. So RIGHT moved it back. So both LEFT and RIGHT move the gray horizontally by 6, but UP doesn't move it vertically?
Maybe the vertical step is 12? 18-12=6, rows 6-17, still free. Hmm, no.
Maybe UP is blocked because the black piece is at the same rows (18-29) on the other side? If the pair is linked and UP moves both 6 up... black is also at rows 18-29, 6 up → 12-23, also free. So no.
Maybe the vertical movement is controlled differently: maybe SPACE or ACTION7 is needed for vertical? Or maybe the piece can only move horizontally, and vertical happens automatically?
Or maybe the movement step is 6, and UP is blocked by the top edge... no, rows 18-29 are far from the top edge.
Let me probe DOWN: if DOWN moves the gray 6 down (18→24), then vertical works downward but not upward? Strange.
Actually, wait — maybe UP was blocked because moving up would cause the gray to... cross? No.
Let me probe DOWN and also try SPACE and ACTION7 to see what they do.
